review_type: Independent review of paired DOCX component probe
finding: The prompt asks for a readable DOCX metric table but specifies no thousands-separator convention. In the controlled pair, changing only two positive monetary cells from $184,672.54/$162,826.17 to $184672.54/$162826.17 changes check_memo_core_metrics from score 1 to score 0. The ungrouped values are numerically identical, and the rule detail identifies precisely those two missing values. The negative estimated decrease stays identical as ($21,846.37) in both artifacts.
independent_checks: Recomputed SHA-256 of both DOCX files; each matches its result.json artifact_sha256.
Opened both files as ZIP containers, tested all members for corruption, and read word/document.xml using the standard library.

Verified both contain the same two-column metric table, six metric rows, headings and negative amount; replacing the two commas in the grouped DOCX document.xml makes its XML exactly equal to the ungrouped version's XML.
Read the probe script: it loads check_code from the pinned metadata and directly invokes check_memo_core_metrics in a Slurm amd-tw-verification job. No task image or full verifier path was invoked.
mechanism: _money uses f'{abs(value):,.2f}' and, for positive values, searches only the grouped string or its dollar-prefixed form. DOCX text is read literally. Its negative-value branch has an ungrouped parenthesized exception, but that exception cannot apply to the two positive cells.
limits: This directly validates only check_memo_core_metrics on synthetic, valid DOCX tables. Neither artifact is a complete task submission.

The probe did not run check_memo_cross_source_control, source_integrity, any LLM item, the controller, binarization, or training. Static source suggests cross_source_control reuses the same money matcher, but no outcome for that component is claimed here.

The sidecar metadata contains eight non-gate items with default weight 1. A hypothetical change in exactly one item would alter its raw weighted score by 1/8 if all else were held fixed, but no total reward was measured.
The older 55624 probe changed the negative amount as well and therefore does not isolate the positive-format effect; 55626 is the decisive paired result.
additional_testing: None requested or performed after the isolated rerun.
